text:
alex: Working on TF refactor: splitting auth and network modules. Open PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4823 Need confirmation on provider pin approach and lockfile regen strategy. Planning to pin providers at root and rely on module constraints. Any blockers?
jordan: Linking state mv plan? Will this require refactor of provider aliases? also secrets path for k8s secret names?
alex: Yes state move: we'll mv aws_iam and gke resources to new modules. Provider aliasing used inside modules. My question: should we hoist providers to root with pinned versions in root lockfile OR keep module-level provider blocks and run "terraform providers lock" per module?
priya: @alex I'd hoist to root for simplicity and single lockfile for CI. But we need to ensure module authors keep constraints compatible. Suggest: root providers with explicit version = "~> 4.50" for aws, and set required_providers in each module with version constraint but without provider block. That way lockfile regen at root covers all.
sam: Agree with @priya. Also, add a canary deploy in staging. I'll run a quick plan if you push the PR and mark it 'ready-for-smoke'.
alex: Here's the snippet I'm proposing in root providers.tf:
```hcl
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = { source = "hashicorp/aws" version = "~> 4.50" }
    google = { source = "hashicorp/google" version = "~> 4.70" }
  }
}

provider "aws" { region = var.region }
provider "google" { project = var.gcp_project }
```
Modules will remove provider blocks and accept providers via 'providers = { aws = aws }' where needed.
jordan: If we hoist, don't forget to update module registry constraints for '>= 0.1.0' style. Also, watch for provider alias references in existing resources. We might need temporary aliases and a migration plan.
priya: On lockfile regen: use `terraform init -upgrade -get-plugins=true` in a CI job, then commit .terraform.lock.hcl. Add a lint that fails if lockfile diff exists unless PR title includes 'regen-lockfile'.
infra-bot: CI: plan/test job for PR 4823 queued · status: running :gear:
alex: Good call. For secrets, we currently map k8s secret names using module outputs. Need to ensure secret paths don't change. Proposed mapping: keep old path aliases via compatibility variables and add deprecation notes.
sam: Quick smoke checklist:
- push branch
- run `make infra-plan` in staging
- validate outputs unchanged
- apply in staging with drift window
I'll take it after PR open.
jordan: One more: if any module has provider 'constraints' pinned tighter than root, terraform will error. We should scan with a small script:
```bash
rg "required_providers|version =" modules/ -n || true
```
alex: I'll add a pre-merge check to fail if any module has provider blocks. Also will run the scan and open a follow-up to update module constraints. Will mark PR w/ 'regen-lockfile' if I commit lockfile.
priya: :thumbsup: Once you add CI guard and staging smoke, I can approve.
sam: I'll schedule a 30-min window tomorrow 10:30am PT for the smoke apply.
alex: Thanks all. I'll push the PR today and ping when ready. tagging @sam @priya for rollout.
